waivers.summary: Power/thermal characterisation requires physical far-edge hardware; not measurable in this repository.
Hypervisor/CPU/provider compatibility matrix cells other than 'reference-model/CPython' need real vhost-user/vDPA targets.
Zero-copy/kernel-bypass optimisation is a property of the production backend, not the reference model; batching is implemented and measured here.

technical_debt.summary: io_model reports errors as free text; runtime/errors.classify_model_error maps them. Move to coded exceptions in io_model at next major.
Evidence sealing is HMAC; replace with Sigstore/in-toto signatures bound to CI identity.
